payload.finding: t0036 did not improve the prior champion: val_bpb=0.977341, delta=+0.004243. Hypothesis: The output softcap may be limiting the metric directly rather than only stabilising training. The head computes logits, casts to float32, then applies 15*tanh(logits/15), which asymptotically bounds every logit to plus or minus 15 and, more importantly, compresses differences once magnitudes approach that scale. val_bpb is a cross-entropy quantity, so it is exactly the size of the gap between the correct logit and its competitors that sets the achievable loss on confident predictions, and a model at 0.973 bpb makes many highly confident predictions on a small 8192-token vocabulary. payload.finding: t0046 did not improve the prior champion: val_bpb=0.972982, delta=+0.000278. Hypothesis: Gating is the one control-path addition that has paid in this campaign, and attention output has none. The value-embedding path is gated per head by 2*sigmoid of a linear map on 128 residual channels, and widening exactly that gate from 32 to 128 channels produced the only champion improvement in twenty nodes. payload.finding: t0103 did not improve the prior champion: val_bpb=0.974490, delta=+0.007204. Hypothesis: Averaging the endpoint of the trajectory paid 0.001103 in t0096, and the natural question is whether averaging the trajectory itself pays too. Lookahead does that: a slow copy of the weights follows the fast ones by a fraction alpha every k steps, and the fast weights are then reset onto the slow copy, so the optimizer explores from a point that is itself an average of recent iterates rather than from the latest one. It is a different intervention from the EMA, which only changes what is evaluated and never influences training, whereas this changes the path. The conditions here favour it: the run takes about 2870 steps at a batch of 2**17, which is the noisiest per-step gradient this campaign has used, and t0096 established that this model reaches its end as a noisy draw rather than a converged point. The cost is small and checkable, roughly 1GB of traffic every five steps against a 105ms step.

proposal.risk: That interaction is the main hazard and it is specific. Muon maintains a momentum buffer and a second-moment buffer keyed to the parameters it is updating, and Adam maintains exp_avg and exp_avg_sq likewise; Lookahead rewrites the parameters without touching any of that state, so for five steps after each sync the optimizers are correcting a trajectory that no longer exists. payload.finding: t0105 did not improve the prior champion: val_bpb=0.968249, delta=+0.000963. Hypothesis: Logit magnitude is the most sensitive quantity this campaign has found, and only one instrument controls it. The output softcap is the single inherited default that proved suboptimal, and its curve is steep in both directions: 7 costs 0.005206, 10 was the optimum at the old batch, 13 is the optimum now, 30 costs 0.004637. Both failures converge on the same mechanism, damping the gradient into lm_head, and t0039 showed that a uniform learning-rate reduction cannot substitute for it because the cap acts selectively on tokens whose logits have grown large. A z-loss is the other selective instrument for the same quantity: it penalises the log-partition, so it pushes back on exactly the examples whose logits are collectively large, and it does so through the loss rather than by clipping the function. If softcapping this model is worth several thousandths of a bpb, a second, smoother control on the same quantity is the most promising remaining lever.
